title: Be a registered professional engineer
what: Carry out professional engineering work in a prescribed area of engineering only as a registered professional engineer (or under one's direct supervision).

sources.title: Design and Building Practitioners Act 2020 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry out professional engineering work in a prescribed area of engineering unless— (a) the person is a registered professional engineer and the person's registration authorises the person to carry out the professional engineering work,
